items.item: (1) USES.md In brief: the ethics sentences and the how-far parenthesis, by H1-H10 and the first screen's anchor at the page's depth
items.how: The ethics part now reads: 'The ethics emerges from continuation. A life goes on through what sustains it, and going on is not yet an order over courses. Where relations close, read across all steps, so that every continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other, nothing lies outside each one's reach along that relation; on the reading that what has significance from a standpoint is what lies within its center's reach, that is the *continuation condition* (from every standpoint, for anything, its continuation into the future has significance). There, if a life holds its own continuation as an order over courses, *self-concern*, that order already ranks every *widening* above what it widens: one course keeping all another keeps and letting more form, more future ([07 §4]; proved on models, self-concern a hypothesis: mutual dependence gives the condition so read, and under it the order ranks so on a finite listing and, one way, between two courses whose admissions end; the two compose directly, though no single theorem states the composite). On a finite listing, every way of adding up worth that counts each thing above zero ranks the wider course higher, so ranking by widening adds no premise beside the life's own concern. That a life forms such an order is not shown: what the models show of persisting is a filter on what was chosen, not an order formed ([07 §4.9]); how such orders form is the work's open target ([08 §12]). Where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer; ...' H1 (plain words once, the theorem on the human development Proved line), H2, H3, H4, H6 (no time gloss), H7, H8, H9 and H10 (shown: conditional, hypotheses named, finite listing; offered: counting their loss; open: how such orders form, 08 §12). Checked against 07's thesis, §4, §4.4, §4.5, §4.9, 08 §2 and GLOSSARY. The opening sentences (no should, no good and evil, right and wrong forming in people and AI) are unchanged.

First Proved line adds the theorem: 'On a finite listing one course widens another exactly when every additive weighting that counts each listed thing above zero ranks it higher' (Weighting.widens_iff_every_positive). Second: 'On the reading that what has significance from a standpoint is what lies within its center's reach along a relation, the continuation condition held de se is nothing lying outside each center's reach along it. Mutual dependence gives it, along being affected and along affecting, ... read across all steps ([05], [07 §4.9]); where it holds on an acyclic relation, every standpoint has the same center (`«续无外则同一中心»`, [07 §4.5])' (H6, H7; Flow.unrestricted_of_mutuallyDependent). Third: the ranking between level paths 'whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, so that their admissions end' (H8), and 'mutual dependence and this ranking compose directly, though no single theorem states the composite' (H9). Conditional: 'or an order meeting C (`Comparison`)' (H5). The Argued line 'That a life forms ... is argued, not shown' is gone; its content is now an Open line: 'That a life forms self-concern is not shown: going on is not yet such an order, in the proofs it is a hypothesis, and what the models show of persisting is a filter on what was chosen, not an order formed ([07 §4.9]); how scope and order form within the dynamics is the work's open target ([08 §12])' (H3). The second Argued line opens with H4: 'concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one ([07 §3.3])'. The first Open line drops 'The route from mutual dependence ... is not stated as one theorem' (H9: no gap of substance) and keeps 'The ranking is not shown for courses that go on forming without end'. Every line is at most 88 words (limit 90); labels stay in order.

items.item: (3) Chinese: USES.zh.md and USES-EXAMPLES.zh.md mirror every change
items.how: Wording from GLOSSARY.zh as the ch08 agent left it: 跨越所有步来读; 沿这一关系，从每个中心都能到达一切；若把从一个立场看有意义的，读作该立场之中心所能到达的范围，这就是延续条件; 凡给每样东西（定理处：每个所列之物）一个大于零的权重、再把权重相加的计法; 在生命自身的关切之外不另加前提; 生命是否会形成这种次序，尚未表明：模型中的持存只是对所择者的过滤，并不形成次序; 依存若只沿一个方向，对自身延续的关切未必把依存于它的那些也算进来 (它们, not 他们/自己者); 容纳终会止息 and （只证明了这一方向） for 'one way' (astra's Chinese point 9: 单向地 no longer mixes the logical direction with one-way relations); 二者可以直接合成，只是没有一条定理单独陈述合成的结果 (the opening's 合成, without its 尚无); 它在一个无环的关系上成立时，每一个立场都有同一个中心; C 说成一个满足 `Comparison`（C）的次序 / 即要求一个次序把一个进程排在它所扩大的每一个进程之上; 保住渔民自身的延续，并不要求保住贻贝床 (the brief's H4 Chinese); 交接 drops 在扩大之读法下. 'There,' is 在这样的关系中, not 在那里 (Fable's sixth-pass Chinese point 1). Credits: 对排序结果所预设的范围与次序的说明，它称之为“一种澄清了的伦理，而不是一种有了根据的伦理”, so 称之为 attaches to the review (astra's point 10). The self-concern line moved from 已论证 to a second 未决 line, as in English.
